title: The STRONG Women’s title crosses promotions
summary: The STRONG Women’s championship links competitors from several promotions. Giulia’s reign and Stephanie Vaquer’s breakthrough lead to a winner-takes-all meeting with Mercedes Moné.

chapters.title: Giulia takes the STRONG championship
chapters.result: Giulia defeats Willow Nightingale for the STRONG Women’s title.
chapters.context: The Stardom wrestler carries New Japan’s newer women’s championship into a substantial reign.

chapters.title: Vaquer defeats Giulia
chapters.result: Stephanie Vaquer wins the STRONG Women’s championship.
chapters.context: The CMLL representative ends Giulia’s reign at a Stardom event, underlining the belt’s cross-promotional identity.

chapters.title: Moné wins the double-title showdown
chapters.result: Moné defeats Vaquer, retaining the TBS title and winning STRONG gold.
chapters.context: The two champions meet at the joint event, where Mercedes leaves with both belts.
